claims.evidence: Curator-chosen identifiers: one source per (SILAC channel x replicate experiment). mqpar.xml groups the 18 raw files into experiments 1,2,3 (file names rep1/rep2/rep3); paper Fig. 5B defines 3 SILAC conditions.
Paper Results & Fig. 5B legend: '(1) a negative control using biotin-phenol only (light)'; mqpar labelMods[0] empty = light. PRIDE:0000326 'SILAC light'.
Paper: '(2) active APEX2 labelling without DNA damage (medium)'; mqpar labelMods[1]='Arg6;Lys4'. PRIDE:0000327.
Paper: '(3) APEX2 labelling following IR-induced DNA damage (heavy)'; mqpar labelMods[2]='Arg10;Lys8'. PRIDE:0000325.

claims.value: biotin-phenol only, no H2O2 (APEX2 labelling negative control)
claims.evidence: Fig. 5B legend: 'negative control (biotin phenol (BP) only, no H2O2; light)'. Same channel map in all 3 replicates: no swap described in paper; proteinGroups shows bait UFC1 log2 M/L 4.3/4.7/4.6 and H/L 5.0/3.0/3.1 in experiments 1/2/3, consistent with light = non-labelled control in every replicate. IR status of light channel not stated, so not asserted. Free text: no NCIT/EFO term covers this condition (validator warning).

claims.value: biotin-phenol + H2O2 APEX2 labelling, no ionizing radiation
claims.evidence: Fig. 5B legend: '(2) APEX2-catalysed biotinylation without DNA damage (medium)'; BP 0.5 mM 2 h, H2O2 1 mM 2 min (Methods). Medium vs heavy swap cannot be excluded from ratios (both active); paper describes one fixed assignment.

claims.value: biotin-phenol + H2O2 APEX2 labelling, ionizing radiation 10 Gy
claims.evidence: Fig. 5B legend: '(3) APEX2-catalysed biotinylation following ionising radiation (IR, 10 Gy, ~30 min; heavy)'.

The deposit defines three replicate experiments. mqpar.xml <experiments> assigns files rep1_1..6 to experiment 1, rep2_* to 2 and rep3_* to 3, and summary.txt/proteinGroups.txt report ratios separately for experiments 1, 2 and 3. Raw file names carry rep1/rep2/rep3. Each experiment is a separate SILAC mix with all three channels. Calling them biological replicates (independent cultures/labelling) is inferred from this structure; the paper does not state the replicate type for the APEX2 screen.
18 deposited RAW files, all listed in mqpar filePaths; each file carries all three SILAC channels (multiplicity 3).
mqpar <fractions> 1..6 per experiment; summary.txt Fraction column; files suffixed _1.._6.
Protocol: proteins separated on 4-12% Bis-Tris SDS-PAGE gels and in-gel digested; MaxQuant defines 6 fractions per sample (gel slices). PRIDE:0000568 verified in OLS.
Each fraction file injected once (one file per experiment/fraction in mqpar).
PRIDE organism NEWT:9606; U2OS is human (Cellosaurus OX NCBI_TaxID=9606).

Paper Results: 'APEX2 was fused to UFC1 and ectopically expressed in U2OS cells'; SILAC Methods: 'U2OS cells were grown for two weeks in DMEM for SILAC'; file names contain U2OS. EFO:0002869 label 'U2OS' (Cellosaurus DR EFO_0002869).
Cellosaurus AC CVCL_0042, ID U2OS.
Cellosaurus ID line: U2OS.
Cellosaurus DI NCIt C9145 / ORDO 668 Osteosarcoma; MONDO:0009807 'osteosarcoma'. Donor disease of the cell line.
Cellosaurus 'Derived from site: In situ; Bone, tibia; UBERON=UBERON_0000979'; UBERON:0000979 label 'tibia'.
Cellosaurus AG 15Y (donor age at sampling).
Cellosaurus SX Female.
Cellosaurus 'Population: Caucasian' mapped to HANCESTRO:0005 'European ancestry' (inferred mapping).
Cultured U2OS cell line; 'cell line' is in the contract's fixed value list.
Methods: 'DMEM for SILAC (Thermofisher)' with light/medium/heavy Lys/Arg, 10% dialysed FBS; NCIT:C185409 'Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium'.
RAW headers (rep1_1, rep3_6) contain 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS'; PRIDE instruments MS:1002634; paper: Q Exactive Plus. Agree.
PRIDE experimentTypes PRIDE:0000627; protocol 'operated in data-dependent mode... 15 most intense ions'.

The column records the enzyme used for digestion (TERMS.tsv: 'Enzyme or chemical used for protein digestion'). The protocol says samples were 'in-gel digested using trypsin', with 'strict trypsin specificity'. MS:1001251 'Trypsin' was verified in OLS. NOTE: the deposited MaxQuant search used the cleavage rule Trypsin/P (mqpar.xml <enzymes>Trypsin/P</enzymes>, MS:1001313). That rule is a search setting, not the wet-lab agent; reprocessing that needs to reproduce the deposited search should use Trypsin/P. sdrf-tools reconcile exits 0.
Protocol: fragmented by higher energy C-trap dissociation (HCD); MS:1000422 is the PSI-MS term for HCD.
'Fragment spectra were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyser.'
'Survey full scan MS spectra (m/z 300-1,700) were acquired in the Orbitrap.'
mqpar mainSearchTol 4.5 ppm (searchTolInPpm=true). Paper prose says 6 ppm; deposited search parameters take precedence.
mqpar/parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm'; Orbitrap MS2; paper '20 ppm in HCD MS2 mode'.
Methods: beads 'eluted ... with 3x SDS loading buffer containing freshly added 1 mM DTT'; the only reducing step stated before alkylation.
Protocol: 'Samples were alkylated by addition of 5.5 mM chloroacetamide'.
mqpar fixedModifications 'Carbamidomethyl (C)'.
mqpar variableModifications 'Acetyl (Protein N-term)'.
mqpar variableModifications 'Oxidation (M)'.

mqpar variableModifications 'NEM'; NEMSites.txt lists 523 sites, all on C; lysis buffer contained 10 mM N-ethylmaleimide (Methods). UNIMOD:108 'Nethylmaleimide' = N-ethylmaleimide on cysteines. Not mentioned in paper/PRIDE search prose; deposited search wins.
mqpar labelMods medium 'Arg6;Lys4'; Methods: L-lysine [4,4,5,5-D4], L-arginine-U-13C6 (medium).
mqpar labelMods heavy 'Arg10;Lys8'; Methods: L-lysine-U-13C6,15N2, L-arginine-U-13C6,15N4 (heavy). Labels encoded as Variable on every row, as in curated SILAC SDRFs (e.g. sandbox/PXD011001).

Filled by build from ms-proteomics template.

Paper Results and Fig. 5B: the light channel is '(1) a negative control using biotin-phenol only' (no H2O2). PRIDE:0000905 'negative control', a child of PRIDE:0000895 verified live in OLS. The column is licensed via the sample-metadata layer (sdrf-tools contract lists characteristics[sample type]).

Medium (APEX2 labelling, no IR) and heavy (APEX2 labelling + 10 Gy IR) are the two experimental conditions compared against light (M/L and H/L ratios, Fig. 5D). PRIDE:0001013 'study sample' verified live in OLS.

limitations: techsdrf not installed: instrument verified by HTTP-range reading RAW headers only (2 of 18 files); collision energy, MS2 analyzer and scan settings not machine-verified from raw files.

sdrf-tools fetch failed (Europe PMC HTTP 500 twice); record gathered manually from PRIDE v3 API, NCBI efetch (PMC 13415529) and the deposited MaxQuant files. Europe PMC full-text XML also returned 500.

Medium vs heavy channel assignment per replicate rests on the paper's single stated design (Fig. 5B); a medium/heavy label swap would not be detectable from proteinGroups ratios (both channels are active labelling). The light=control assignment is cross-checked by bait (UFC1) M/L and H/L enrichment in all 3 experiments.
Whether the light (BP-only) channel was irradiated is not stated; IR status not asserted for light rows.
Transient expression of UFC1-2HA-APEX2 in all channels is not encoded: characteristics[genotype] is licensed only by clinical-metadata, which does not apply.
characteristics[treatment]/factor value[treatment] are free text (no NCIT/EFO term for these APEX2 conditions): 3 parse_sdrf ontology warnings.
passage number, sample storage temperature and cell type are 'not available' (not reported; Cellosaurus gives no cell type).
Precursor tolerance: paper prose 6 ppm vs mqpar main search 4.5 ppm; mqpar used.

Neutravidin enrichment of biotinylated proteins (paper Methods: lysates mixed 1:1:1, neutravidin pull-down) is not encoded. characteristics[enrichment process] is licensed, but it must be a child of EFO:0009090, and OLS shows no descendant covering biotin/streptavidin/neutravidin affinity enrichment (descendants are cell-isolation methods, methylated-DNA and phosphoprotein enrichment). I did not add a non-ontology free-text value.
characteristics[individual] (recommended by human) is omitted. The cell line has one Cellosaurus donor, but no donor identifier is published.
comment[sdrf template] declares ms-proteomics v1.2.0, the released upstream version. The spec submodule pinned in sdrf-skills (dc9be283) lists 1.1.0 as latest.

Biological (vs technical) nature of the 3 replicates is inferred from the deposit's 3 MaxQuant experiments and the rep1-3 file names. The paper's 'performed in triplicate' sentence refers to the protein-concentration assay and is not used as evidence.
comment[cleavage agent details] records the wet-lab enzyme, Trypsin. The deposited search rule was Trypsin/P (MS:1001313).
